stem:
[Image: A ruler measuring the length of a pipe]

What is the length of the pipe being measured?
figure_description: A horizontal ruler labeled "Meters (m)" at the top has major tick marks from 0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, with minor tick marks halfway between each major tick mark (representing increments of 0.05). Below the ruler, a gray cylindrical pipe is positioned horizontally. Dimension lines with arrows indicate the length being measured from the left end of the pipe, which aligns with 0 on the ruler, to the right end of the pipe, which aligns with the tick mark halfway between 0.8 and 0.9.
